metadata.name: MURMURATIONS by Lordcalder
metadata.description: Murmurations is a collection of 420 generative 3D micro-worlds. Far beyond static art, each Murmuration is a living ecosystem featuring procedural terrain, dynamic weather, and complex flocking algorithms. Take the wheel of a Lunar Rover, navigate active volcanoes, and sweep your eyes across different wildlife roaming each unique world. With mathematically hidden ultra-rares - including Moons, Solid Gold, Sculpted Marble, and Prismatic Rainbow worlds—don’t just collect art, collect the universe!
